source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Stress the reliability

Run FIO for all drives with below parameter
time_based
runtime=43200
bs=4K
rw=randrw
numjobs=32(Depends on CPU design)
size=4g
IO_depth=32

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System should wroks fine after FIO finish.
2. Sytem log shouldn’t' have error
3. IOPS should be  at least 80% within the Thero. value of spec

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Creates a 60-second, 512-byte, 512 MiB randread job at iodepth 32 on an operator-designated target.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly demands an explicit target but materially changes the workload from 12-hour 4 KiB randrw/32 jobs/4 GiB to 60-second 512-byte randread/512 MiB.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; restores exact recipe, allowlisted empty targets, destructive-write approval, health monitoring and specification comparison.
historical_reviews.round_02: No separate exact-code round-02 entry was found.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No exact standalone handoff was found; the row was read directly and compared with V2.

original_test_intent: Stress every designated M.2 drive for 43,200 seconds with the specified 4 KiB mixed random I/O workload at 32 jobs and queue depth 32 over a 4 GiB region, then verify host/storage health, clean logs and IOPS at or above 80% of the approved theoretical specification.
original_method: Enumerate and positively allowlist each empty non-system M.2 target, validate the referenced script and exact fio job, capture drive/host/thermal baselines, run the approved workload on all targets with persistent output and monitoring, then compare per-drive IOPS with the owner-supplied theoretical value and inspect health/log deltas.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies and approves immutable M.2 target identities, job/specification and destructive-write plan and later issues the verdict. Target supply and approval do not make the core PARTIAL; after allowlisting, job execution, monitoring, collection and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Per-drive slot, serial, namespace/device path, mount/OS/RAID membership and explicit empty-test status
fio version and exact job/script content preserving time_based, runtime=43200, bs=4K, rw=randrw, numjobs=32 or approved CPU-specific value, size=4g and iodepth=32
Per-drive theoretical IOPS definition and 80% calculation method
Stable power, maintenance window, write/endurance/thermal approval and output-retention location
Health/log/thermal monitoring cadence and safe abort conditions
safety_requirements: Never write to an OS, mounted, in-use, protected, ambiguous or non-allowlisted drive; revalidate identity immediately before launch.
Preserve every source workload parameter unless an explicit project plan records an override; never substitute the DeepSeek short randread job.
Stop on target-identity drift, media/I/O errors, critical SMART/NVMe/thermal/power alarms or host instability according to the approved plan.
Preserve the first failure and partial fio output; do not auto-retry, remap targets or repair/reformat media.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the immutable target allowlist, fio/job/script hashes, specification threshold and pre-test drive/host health.
After one-user approval, launch the exact job on the approved drives, monitor process/thermal/health/log state and retain complete per-drive results.
Calculate actual-versus-theoretical IOPS, summarize errors and health deltas as Tool Result without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve each exact target, workload parameters, theoretical IOPS source and destructive-write/endurance exposure.
Decide any CPU-design-specific numjobs override and safety-stop thresholds before launch.
Review performance and health evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe as a coverage replacement: bs=512, size=512M, runtime=60 and randread do not match bs=4K, size=4g, runtime=43200 and randrw; it also omits numjobs=32 and all-drive orchestration. Its explicit target guard is useful but insufficient without identity/mount checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the reviewed internal fio-stress script or an equivalent pinned fio job that exactly implements the source recipe on an immutable allowlist, with JSON output and independent health monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: time_based, 43,200 seconds/720 minutes, 4K, randrw, 32 jobs subject to CPU design, 4g, iodepth 32, all drives, referenced script and 15/720-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: PINNED FIO JOB WITH STRUCTURED OUTPUT
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a versioned job file and referenced-script hash, fio JSON output per target, pre-launch identity assertions, concurrent SMART/NVMe/thermal/log sampling and deterministic 80%-threshold calculations.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Approved M.2 devices and CPU/storage topology only.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS/kernel, fio, script, drive firmware, controller and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: The referenced internal fio-stress script and project performance specification must be reviewed; no alternate fio workload is asserted as equivalent.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds machine-verifiable target safety and evidence formatting without changing workload semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; all approved drives and the full mixed-write duration remain required unless a project override is explicitly reported.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Allowlist, job/script, theoretical IOPS and monitor/abort plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Time-based mixed writes can consume endurance and expose thermal throttling; performance comparison depends on the exact theoretical baseline.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve different duration, numjobs, target set or other parameters. The report must name each override and may claim only that project plan—not completion of the master 43,200-second all-drive recipe.
expected_evidence: Per-drive immutable identity/slot/mount/usage allowlist, baseline health and approval
fio/script/job versions/hashes and exact resolved parameters for every target
Complete JSON/stdout/stderr with runtime, IOPS/BW/latency/errors plus thermal/SMART/NVMe and system-log timeline
Per-drive 80% theoretical comparison, post-health/log state, completed duration, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure, 720-minute machine time and criteria consistently define the long mixed-I/O reliability/performance test. CPU-dependent numjobs and theoretical IOPS are project inputs, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workload and acceptance dimensions are clear. Target/spec/package/approval are readiness inputs; once supplied, the full core and evidence are automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains explicit target selection but rejects its coverage-breaking short randread substitution and PARTIAL label.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains exact recipe, target and safety gates while advancing capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under the V3.1 target/approval rule.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds all-drive identity locking, project-override claim boundaries and deterministic performance evidence.

review_improvement: Restores every source fio parameter and makes destructive scope, endurance, health and 80%-of-spec evaluation auditable without conflating engineer verdict with execution capability.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fio execution, monitoring, logging and numerical comparison are automatable after a user supplies the targets and specification. Because no manual physical stimulus is intrinsic, target approval does not justify PARTIAL. The DeepSeek workload would materially reduce coverage and is rejected.
